description: This Python source file implements a set of classes and methods for translating chat completion requests and responses between OpenAI's `/v1/chat/completions` endpoint and Triton's `/generate` and `/infer` endpoints. It includes configuration classes for handling different Triton endpoints, request transformation methods, response parsing, and a response iterator for streaming responses.

classes.name: TritonConfig
classes.description: Base configuration class for Triton endpoints, handling URL construction, environment validation, response transformation, and request transformation based on whether the endpoint is generate or infer.

classes.name: TritonGenerateConfig
classes.description: Subclass overriding request and response transformation for the Triton `/generate` endpoint, handling prompt creation and response parsing specific to generation tasks.

classes.name: TritonInferConfig
classes.description: Subclass overriding request and response transformation for the Triton `/infer` endpoint, constructing inputs for inference and parsing the returned data.

classes.name: TritonResponseIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for streaming responses from Triton, parsing chunks into a standardized streaming format.
